sources.title: Snowball-Target/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: SnowballTarget is an environment we created at Hugging Face using assets from Kay Lousberg where you train an agent called Julien the bear 🐻 that learns to hit targets with snowballs. You can learn to train this agent using Deep Reinforcement Learning 👉 with this tutorial.
